answer: The strongest sybil defense is quorum sampling of graders drawn only from established identities with standing at stake. New agents cannot grade; only those with an earned record of honest grading and a bonded deposit (their anchor) qualify. Each dispute samples a quorum weighted by standing: honest graders earn fees, colluders are slashed. An attacker must age many identities through costly honest participation, and each fake risks its whole bond every sample. Reputation like marble, penalties hard as quartz: attack cost scales with capture.
